methods.name: DPL
methods.description: A model-agnostic and dataset-independent method that understands the semantic diversity of predicates and effectively integrates them during the inference phase to achieve unbiased scene graph generation.

methods.name: TDE
methods.description: An unbiased scene graph generation method that performs unbiased prediction from biased training.

methods.name: DLFE
methods.description: An unbiased scene graph generation method that performs unbiased prediction from biased training.

methods.name: Motifs
methods.description: A baseline model used for the PredCls task.

methods.name: Motifs + re-weighting
methods.description: Motifs model combined with re-weighting for predicate prediction

methods.name: Motifs + DPL
methods.description: Model incorporating DPL that provides relatively unbiased predictions with fine-grained predicates

methods.name: sample-relation feature matching process
methods.description: Learns the range that can be represented by each predicate and estimates the specific semantics associated with relation features by matching relation features near prototypes with generated samples.

methods.name: orthogonal loss
methods.description: Prevents unexpected overlap between unrelated predicates or sample distributions caused by the symmetry of the assumed normal distribution around each prototype.

methods.name: Semantic Diversity-aware Prototype-based Learning (DPL)
methods.description: A prototype-based learning framework evaluated with a Motifs backbone to learn prototype representations and variances.

methods.name: PCA visualization
methods.description: Principal Component Analysis used to visualize prototypes, relation features of subject-object pairs, and prototype samples.

methods.name: matching loss
methods.description: A loss used in conjunction with orthogonal loss to effectively learn variance.

methods.name: IMP
methods.description: Baseline model evaluated on the VG dataset

methods.name: Semantic Diversity aware Prototype-based Learning (DPL)
methods.description: A framework that obtains the relation feature from each subject-object pair, creates a prototype corresponding to each predicate, and conducts prototype-based biased training to encourage each relation feature to approach its corresponding prototype.

methods.name: Prototype-based Biased Training
methods.description: Trains each relation feature to become closer to the prototype of its ground-truth class based on Euclidean distance.

methods.description: Object detection backbone used within the scene graph generation (SGG) model pipeline.
